title: DiversityMedQA: A Benchmark for Assessing Demographic Biases in Medical Diagnosis using Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Swapping male and female details, such as pronouns and gender-specific terms, in medical board exam questions (MedQA) and evaluating whether the diagnostic accuracy of Large Language Models changes between the original and counterfactual prompts.

Injecting phrases specifying a patient's ethnicity (e.g., African, Caucasian, Asian, Hispanic, or Native American descent) into medical diagnostic questions and comparing the models' diagnostic accuracy across the different demographic groups.
